paragraphs.text: The Odyssey block is the seventh Magic: The Gathering block , comprising the large expansion Odyssey ( ) and the two small expansions Torment ( ) and Judgment ( ). The block came out in 2001–2002.
On the development codenames for the Odyssey block, MTG.com columnist Mark Rosewater writes:
The primary theme of Odyssey block was the graveyard, or "graveyard matters".
The block introduced keywords Flashback , Madness , and Threshold .
Odyssey block has two mega cycles.
